content: kableExtra 1.4.0 (CRAN, active): wraps knitr::kable() for styled HTML and LaTeX tables. ~48 dependencies. HTML and LaTeX only (no Word). Regex-based architecture acknowledged as hard to maintain/extend. Development has slowed; not actively evolving. For multi-format (HTML+PDF+Word) R package use, kableExtra is inadequate for Word and less future-proof than tinytable or gt.
